'''Virat Kohli''' (born 5 November 1988) is an Indian international [[cricket]]er.

After winning the [[2024 Men's T20 World Cup|2024 T20 World Cup]] being named Player of the Match award in the [[2024 Men's T20 World Cup final|final]], Kohli announced his retirement from T20Is. On 12 May 2025, at the age of 36, he announced his retirement from the Test cricket.

== International career ==
Kohli regained form and was named the full-time Test captain following [[MS Dhoni]]'s retirement during the [[2014–15 Border–Gavaskar Trophy|tour of Australia]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jones |first=Dean |title=Kohli to lead}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
In 2013, Tendulkar retired from international cricket, Kohli, who played alongside Tendulkar in the team, honoured him by presenting him with a sacred thread.
